description: This file defines the MockRemoteCellModemCluster class, which extends MockCluster to simulate a remote cell modem cluster with power status attributes and controls.

classes.name: MockRemoteCellModemCluster
classes.description: A mock class representing a remote cell modem cluster with power status capabilities.

methods.name: MockRemoteCellModemCluster
methods.description: Constructor initializing the mock remote cell modem cluster with specific endpoint and EUI.

methods.description: Returns attribute data bytes based on the AttributeInfo provided, specifically for power status.

methods.description: Sets the power status of the modem and sends the attribute report.
